scenes.dialogue: Your bank account is frozen over a few disputed credits, and you ask a court to free it. Can the court order the police to investigate your account instead?
It happened to a young man in Kasaragod. He asked the Kerala High Court to free his account, but a judge ordered a police probe. Could a court do that?
